verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's docs claim access to 150+ customizable legal documents, which matches the core of the story. They also list an operating agreement and attorney consultations as backup for questions the templates don't cover. Evidence is a single bundled line, though: access is time-limited (1 year with an LLC package), and a lawyer in the community cautions that documents like operating agreements are not truly routine commodities. Missing for 10: confirmation that the library includes NDAs, contracts and policies; evidence that templates are attorney-vetted; independent hands-on corroboration of template quality; standalone ongoing access.
